proof: For each rigid constant-relative-translation interval, distance(t)>=min(endpoint distances)-relativeSpeed*intervalDuration/2. Adaptive subdivision certifies2mm clearance or returns a sampled collision/clearance witness or unresolved status.
limitations: Prescribed gate/pad stroke and piece velocities, not actuator or force-coupled movement
Piece orientation is fixed per gate trajectory; no time-varying rotation, deformation or normal load model
Gate relative-speed bound is exact for the two prescribed orthogonal translations; not a bound on real hardware
Pad tests hold the posed piece stationary; exact swept boxes avoid mistaking sample-only absence of overlap for proof
Pose clearance contract is conditional and separate from controller implementation and selected sensing
A certified gate path does not establish pad preload, capture, structural or actuator acceptance
